heading: Helping drivers deliver packages within two days holds the key to achieving optimal delivery goals!
eyebrow: 🔍 Identify opportunities for teams with Journey Maps.

blocks.html: To achieve the understanding of the whole delivery process, we conducted key interviews with SMEs, focusing on four main objectives.
Get familiar with the scenarios of delivery routine and duties.
Understand package status circulations in the whole delivery process.

blocks.html: By mapping out the interaction points throughout the whole delivery process, we identified the main direction and key points of the design for the next step.

Prioritize monitoring the delivery completion rates for packages labeled as “ < 1 Day” and “ <2 Day”, since these tasks are directly linked to KPIs and lines up with achieving the ideal delivery rate.
The delivery drivers are all full-time workers. More than 70% of the delivery drivers at Espoirer are typically experienced drivers, and they are often assigned to specific areas.
